about_the_game:
Unicycle Gorilla: The One-Wheeled Primate Who Can’t Brake!

Hop on (or wobble onto) a motorized unicycle and get ready for the wildest monkey business of your life! In Unicycle Gorilla, you’re a gorilla with a unicycle, a helmet two sizes too small, and a dream: to be the fastest furball in the urban jungle! This casual 3D platformer throws you into a world of mad dashes, impossible jumps, and spectacular faceplants, all while you try not to end up in a pile of bananas.

Why Play Unicycle Gorilla?

  • Speedrun Glory: Race against the clock and climb the global leaderboards. Will you be the fastest gorilla on Earth or just a primate with an overpriced unicycle?

  • Collectibles and Chaos: Grab bananas for extra points, dodge bombs, and hit checkpoints with VFX and sound effects that scream “I’M HERE!”

  • Hilarious Physics: The unicycle’s physics are a blend of realism and lunacy. Every crash is a masterpiece, every bounce a comedy goldmine.

  • Monkey Charisma: Our gorilla’s got swagger, with animations ranging from “epic hero” to “I just slipped on a banana peel.”

Perfect for fans of fast-paced games, belly laughs, and friendly (or not-so-friendly) competition. Unicycle Gorilla is the game you didn’t know you needed but won’t be able to put down. Grab your gamepad, strap on that helmet (or at least try), and show the world a gorilla on a unicycle can make history!

Key Features:

  • Global speedrun leaderboards: compete with players worldwide!

  • Intuitive L1/R1 controls for balancing.

  • Vibrant 3D levels stuffed with traps.

  • VFX and audio for checkpoints and collectibles.

  • Comedic animations and unpredictable physics.

  • Gamepad support and smooth optimization.

Get ready to roar, crash, and bounce back in Unicycle Gorilla! The jungle’s calling, and the timer’s ticking!
